zh.plugin.name: K-Vault
zh.plugin.desc: 给「新建远程」加一个 K-Vault 类型：填站点地址和令牌，测通后一键建好远程。上传仍由主程序完成。
zh.panel.ready: 站点和令牌都填好了，可以建远程
zh.panel.todo: 先填站点地址；建远程还需要令牌
zh.check.unset: 未填（只能浏览，不能上传）
zh.hint.site: 填你打开 K-Vault 网站的那个地址，例如 https://kv.example.com。结尾多写的 /dav 会被自动去掉。
zh.hint.remote: 建出来的远程类型是 webdav——K-Vault 在 rclone 里本来就是 webdav，只是多了几个参数。上传还是要靠主程序：站点上传接口要发文件，插件发不了。
zh.site.bad_base: 站点地址要以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
zh.site.missing_token: 建远程需要访问令牌：WebDAV 通道只读，上传要靠令牌
zh.site.max_file_default: 站点没报单文件上限，按默认 {0} MB 算
zh.remote.bad_name: 远程名不能包含冒号、斜杠或空格
zh.remote.provider_fail: 无法向 rclone 查询后端列表：{0}
zh.remote.no_provider: 当前连着的 rclone 没有 webdav 后端，远程没创建（{0}）
zh.remote.no_provider_empty: 后端列表是空的，先确认 rclone 连上了

en.plugin.name: K-Vault
en.plugin.desc: Adds a K-Vault type to New Remote: site address plus token, tested, then created in one click. Uploading still happens in the main program.
en.req.parse: The request is not valid JSON: {0}
en.panel.ready: Site and token are set; the remote can be created
en.panel.todo: Fill in the site address first; creating a remote also needs a token
en.hint.site: Use the address where you open the K-Vault site, for example https://kv.example.com. A trailing /dav is removed for you.
en.hint.remote: The remote is created as a webdav remote — in rclone K-Vault is webdav with a few extra parameters. Uploading still goes through the main program: the site's upload endpoint sends a file, which a plugin cannot do.
en.site.missing_base: Fill in the site address first
en.site.bad_base: The site address must start with http:// or https://
en.site.missing_token: Creating a remote needs an access token: the WebDAV channel is read-only
en.site.not_json: The site did not return JSON (HTTP {0}): {1}
en.site.max_file_default: the site did not report a size cap; assuming {0} MB
en.remote.need_name: The remote name cannot be empty
en.remote.bad_name: The remote name cannot contain colons, slashes or spaces
en.remote.provider_fail: Cannot ask rclone for its backend list: {0}
en.remote.no_provider: The connected rclone has no webdav backend, so nothing was created ({0})
en.remote.no_provider_empty: The backend list is empty; check that rclone is connected
